required_elements.criterion: Comparison concerns excavated skeletons/photographs of dead historical political rivals, not living fighters.
Cremation was customary: Kameda's damaged bones resulted from proper cremation and royal burial.

Umio's intact uncremated remains showed denial of normal burial; historians inferred defeat, with poisoning by rival's agents and secret disposal as accepted account rather than intactness proving survival.

acceptance: All causal narrative elements required, faithful paraphrases accepted. No arbitrary exact wording, names, counts or narrative decoration beyond rubric. Never give solver missing elements. False/incomplete final gets no and game continues.
